verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and support for connecting Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools to search and manage workspace data. A public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec covers records and lists, and deals are a standard (though default-disabled) object. Attio also markets creating account briefs and full interaction history. missing for 10: explicit documentation that recent emails and interaction history are exposed through the API or MCP tools, the Deal object requires admin activation, no hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent assembling a pre-meeting brief.
